description.zh: 复刻 Command Code 的 Tool Call Repair：在工具执行前确定性修复模型常见的参数漂移（package_proxy tool_name 错位、参数名别名、类型强转、JSON 解码），无法修复时返回精确的字段要求，帮助模型下一轮生成正确格式。
description.en: Command Code style Tool Call Repair: deterministically fix common model parameter drift (package_proxy tool_name misplacement, param aliases, type coercion, JSON decoding) before tool execution; return precise field requirements when unfixable.
